items.title: Jimmy Owens — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Sometimes we traveled in, if it was close, in Herbie’s car. ... I said, Donald, and Herbie Hancock about the book, that they should get this book.

ctx.x: Could you go back and talk about Donald Byrd?

Yeah. So, I studied with Donald Byrd when I was 15 years old. I studied about the trumpet, you know? He had me playing long tones and all the things to make me a better trumpet player, and all the time I was interested in playing jazz. So, I would practice—I’d have a lesson on Saturday and I would practice his stuff that he gave me Friday night and go to my lesson. I was never prepared. So, finally, he said to me this one time that I came there. He said—we were born on the same day, December 9th—he said, “Man, I…
Was Herbie living in the Bronx?
